commands.title: Find large container log files
commands.command: sudo find /var/lib/docker/containers -type f -name '*-json.log' -exec du -h {} + | sort -h | tail -20
commands.description: Show the twenty largest container log files on disk. Useful when Docker is filling the disk but the containers themselves look small.

commands.title: Truncate container log files
commands.description: Empty every container log file, reclaiming the space immediately. The logs are gone: copy anything still needed before running, and set a log rotation limit so it does not recur.
